cnc-ddraw v7.1.0.0 (https://github.com/FunkyFr3sh/cnc-ddraw/releases/tag/v7.1.0.0), MIT license (LICENSE).
Unmodified ddraw.dll and ddraw.ini from the release's cnc-ddraw.zip.

AoESolo uses it only for its hidden bots when the player's game folder has no cnc-ddraw: the bot copy of
the game exe (AOEBOT.EXE) is put in a folder of AoESolo's own together with this ddraw.dll, so the bots run
windowed off screen. The player's game folder and the player's own game are never changed.
